integrity: Mathematical all-order proof plus separately recomputed graph-neighborhood, exhaustive small-case, MILP and construction checks; no independent audit or claim of third-party certification.
scientific_limitations: Only circular and Möbius ladders; exactly eight labelled two-colour solutions, not three-colour census. Published priority not independently certified; a line-graph reformulation could be hidden in other literature.
title: Strong-majority edge index and two-colour rigidity of cyclic cubic ladders
